description: Fork of exp154. Replace LUT-based qk_joint with per-head MLPs (Linear 64→256 → ReLU → Linear 256→64 → LayerNorm 64) producing real-valued Q,K with d_qk=64 per head. Use F.scaled_dot_product_attention (standard PyTorch SDPA) with learnable scale = attn_scale / sqrt(d_qk). H=6 heads, each with its own MLP_Q and MLP_K (independent weights via einsum on grouped tensors). V stays as exp154's v_lut (LUT, d_v=32). out_proj stays as LUT. No qk_v2d (Q/K are real, not ±1 dominance). Total budget ~168M (was 392M) — Q/K params drop from 226M to ~2.4M.
